summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip), unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it to execute a sibling file math_init.js — a ~727KB heavily-obfuscated bundle using string-array rotator obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, n7gIxM numeric array). The obfuscated payload is executed outside Node.js under the fetched Bun runtime, evading Node-based inspection. A Babel React preset has no legitimate need to fetch a separate JS runtime at install time or run an opaque payload; the legitimate @ornikar/babel-preset-react in the ornikar/shared-configs repository is a ~12-line preset with no install-time behavior. The mismatch between the declared purpose (Babel preset) and the shipped install-time dropper + obfuscated blob is consistent with a hijacked or malicious publication under the @ornikar scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
